title: Ben Pazi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 46a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.46a.6): Ulla said, “I was standing before Bar Pazi, and they brought a bird before him; he examined it up to between the wings. The Patriarch’s house sent for him, and he rose and went,” etc. Hyman says that undoubtedly he is Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi.

notes.text: The Aramaic calls the sage in Ulla’s account Ben Pazi. The linked English expands that name to Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi. Hyman makes the same identification emphatically. See also [Heilprin’s entry on Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3464&lang=en).
Hyman gives Bar Pazi in his account, which the body retains.
